title: KGNS+ Honors Anselmo “Chemo” Castro for Decades of Service to Laredo
excerpt: Anselmo “Chemo” Castro was honored Monday as the November KGNS+ Honors recipient, recognizing his decades of service to the Laredo community. He has led both the United Way of Laredo and the Washington’s Birthday Celebration Association.
content:
Anselmo “Chemo” Castro, a longtime Laredo volunteer leader, was honored Monday as the November recipient of the KGNS+ Honors award, recognizing his decades of service to the community, according to KGNS.

Castro has served as president of both the United Way of Laredo and the Washington’s Birthday Celebration Association. He credits his mother with instilling in him the importance of giving back.

“I know for a fact that voluntarism is on the decline, and I’d like that to change. There’s a great need in Laredo, and I think that volunteering goes a long way,” Castro said.

The full story will air Tuesday, Nov. 24, on KGNS News The Late Edition, according to KGNS. Residents can nominate someone for a future KGNS+ Honors recognition through the station.

Sources: KGNS — “KGNS+ Honors Anselmo ‘Chemo’ Castro”, https://www.kgns.tv/2026/11/23/kgns-honors-anselmo-chemo-castro/
